voices.delete.message: "{0}": the reference recording will be deleted. Takes already generated with this voice are kept.
voices.delete.title: Delete this voice?
voices.empty.body: Record yourself or import a clip of a few seconds: any text can then be read in this voice, locally, without sending anything to anyone.
voices.error.tooShort: Clip too short: at least one second of speech is needed.
voices.help.language.body: The language of the clip. It is used to find the voice by language and to guide the automatic transcription; the model can then make this voice speak other languages (possibly with an accent).
voices.help.language.title: Spoken language
voices.help.sample.body: A short recording of the voice to imitate. The model takes its timbre, but also the tone, the pace and the atmosphere of the microphone. Only the first 30 seconds are used.
voices.help.sample.tip: 10 to 30 s, a single voice, no music, no echo or background noise.
voices.help.sample.title: Reference clip
voices.help.transcript.body: The exact text spoken in the clip. Optional, but it helps the model "hear" the voice better and clearly improves the fidelity of cloning with Qwen3. It must match what is said word for word, otherwise it degrades the result.
voices.help.transcript.tip: "Transcribe automatically" suggests a text; always read it and correct it if needed.
voices.help.transcript.title: Transcript of the clip
voices.page.title: My voices
voices.recording.keepGoing: keep going, 15 to 30 s is ideal
voices.recording.title: Recording
voices.studio.import.sub: WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG… or drop it here
voices.studio.name: Name
voices.studio.record.denied: Microphone access was refused by the browser
voices.studio.record.sub: Read a short text, 15 to 30 s
voices.studio.tip.clear: A clear voice, in the tone you want to get back: the model also imitates the emotion and the pace of the clip.
voices.studio.tip.consent: Only clone your own voice, or that of someone who agreed to it.
voices.studio.tip.length: 10 to 30 seconds of a single voice, without music or echo, at a steady distance from the microphone.
voices.studio.tooLong: Only the first {0} seconds will be used.
voices.transcript.label: Transcript of the clip
voices.transcript.noModel: No transcription model installed (see Models → Audio)
voices.transcript.placeholder: What the person says in the clip…
voices.transcript.transcribed: Transcribed automatically from the sample: check it and correct it if needed.
voices.transcript.prefilled: Filled in with the suggested text: correct it if you read something else.
